title: EERA Summer School 2027
about: EERA summer school for doctoral students in educational research, held 28 June to 2 July 2027 at Vilnius University under the theme "On Meaning and Impact of Educational Research". Applications are open from 10 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.
requirements: Preferably a PhD/Doctoral student in the first or second year of their studies

upskill.name: AI Fundamentals for Education
why: Field "Educational research" → objective "Explore practical opportunities for AI across teaching, learning, assessment, student support, research, and academic administration."

Audience "Doctoral students" in educational research → objective "Understand the capabilities, limitations, risks, and principles of responsible AI use in schools, universities, training organizations, and other learning environments."

card_alt: Card for the EERA Summer School 2027 of the European Educational Research Association (EERA) in Vilnius, Lithuania, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo is an aerial view of Trakai Island Castle on its lake in Trakai, Lithuania, not Vilnius.
